model_tools.title: Before diagnosis: model relationships and geometry repair
model_tools.help: Check adjacent faces, overlap segmentation, Air Walls, and geometry gaps before manually starting IDFRepair.
model_tools.boundary: Checking never changes the original. Apply creates a new derived IDF copy and refreshes the 3D model; you can return to the prior copy at any time.
model_tools.audit_distinction: This prepares the model before IDFRepair diagnosis; these are not EnergyPlus ERR messages.

preflight.title: Check and repair relationships and geometry together
preflight.help: The system explains what it found first. A change is applicable only when the relationship is unique, uses observed coordinates, and does not break child objects.
preflight.checks_title: Checks in this run (all selected by default)
preflight.tolerance_help: Default 0.05 m. A repair is proposed only when the distance is within this value and the correspondence is unique.
preflight.copy_boundary: Checking and previewing never change the original. Apply creates a derived IDF copy, and the original remains available.
preflight.running: Finding adjacent faces, overlap segments, Air Walls, and geometry gaps…
preflight.empty: Open an IDF to begin. An OSM-derived IDF must complete this step before diagnosis.
preflight.required: The IDF copy is ready. Complete model relationship and geometry checks before manually starting IDFRepair diagnosis.
preflight.checked: Check complete: {safe} items are safe to apply; {review} relationship suggestions need review; {excluded} geometry candidates were excluded by safety rules.
preflight.clean: Check complete: no model relationship or geometry changes are needed. You can start IDFRepair diagnosis.
preflight.applied: A repaired IDF copy is now active and the 3D model has refreshed. The previous copy was not overwritten.
preflight.rolled_back: Returned to the IDF copy from before apply; the 3D model has been restored.
preflight.failed: Model relationship and geometry checking did not complete: {reason}
preflight.apply_failed: The model repairs could not be applied: {reason}
preflight.rollback_failed: Could not return to the prior copy: {reason}
preflight.apply: Apply safe repairs and update the 3D model
preflight.rollback: Return to the copy before apply

geometry_review.safe: The model relationship or geometry adjustment has unique evidence.
geometry_review.safe_next: Locate and review it before applying the safe repair.
geometry_review.review: This is a model-relationship suggestion to review, not an EnergyPlus error or proof that the model is wrong.
geometry_review.review_next: Compare the selected and adjacent surfaces with the technical evidence; this item will not be changed automatically.

reciprocal_surface_pair.safe: The two surfaces have a unique positional, directional, and area match.
reciprocal_surface_pair.safe_next: Review both rooms, then apply the safe repair.
reciprocal_surface_pair.review: The surfaces may be adjacent, but overlap, direction, or pairing evidence is not unique.
reciprocal_surface_pair.review_next: Review both rooms and boundaries; preserve the input when evidence is insufficient.

split_and_pair.safe: One surface can be split along trusted existing boundaries and paired one-to-one.
split_and_pair.safe_next: Review the split outline before applying the safe repair.
split_and_pair.review: The split boundary or child-object relationship is not uniquely proven.
split_and_pair.review_next: Review windows, doors, and adjacent surfaces rather than guessing a split.

resegment_and_pair.safe: Complete overlap evidence supports resegmentation and one-to-one pairing.
resegment_and_pair.safe_next: Review the overlap outline before applying the safe repair.
resegment_and_pair.review: Overlap, coplanarity, or area evidence is incomplete.
resegment_and_pair.review_next: Compare the locator and coordinates; preserve the input if uncertain.

vertex_snap.safe: This vertex can align to an existing trusted coordinate to remove a small offset.
vertex_snap.safe_next: Review the before/after vertex location before applying the safe repair.
vertex_snap.review: This is an excluded or ambiguous snap candidate, not an error that must be fixed.
vertex_snap.review_next: Only change it when the surfaces are confirmed related; it will not snap automatically.

canonicalize_air_boundary.safe: Equivalent AirBoundary constructions can share one referenced object.
canonicalize_air_boundary.safe_next: This is model-wide; review the affected count without fitting the camera to the whole model.
canonicalize_air_boundary.review: The AirBoundary references cannot yet be safely unified.
canonicalize_air_boundary.review_next: Review construction intent and all references first.

direct.title: Pair adjacent faces directly
direct.help: The two faces uniquely match in position, area, and direction; they will reference each other with indoor sun and wind exposure disabled.

split.title: Split one face into matching segments
split.help: Adjacent rooms already provide segmented boundaries; the large face is split along those observed boundaries without averaging coordinates.

resegment.title: Resegment overlapping regions
resegment.help: Existing correct segments are kept, missing segments are added, and each segment is paired.

review.title: Relationship suggestions to review
review.help: The system does not auto-change ambiguous, incomplete, or child-bearing surfaces.

evidence.title: Excluded geometry candidates
evidence.help: Safety rules excluded these candidates. They are not model errors that must be fixed, but their evidence remains available.

preflight.open_navigator: Every issue and location appears in the left navigator without truncation.
preflight.apply_action: Apply relationship and geometry repairs first

audit.title: Model relationship checks
audit.help: Find potentially unreasonable room adjacency, boundary conditions, and surface pairing.
audit.read_only: Check first; do not change the file
audit.read_only_boundary: This step only lists suspicious locations for comparison; it creates no change, writes no IDF, and cannot bypass later validation.

checks.pairing: Do adjacent surfaces match each other?
checks.construction: Is each construction used in the right place?
checks.airboundary: Is the air boundary used reasonably?

check_help.topology: Checks vertex count, duplicate vertices, self-intersection, coplanarity, and usable area.
check_help.pairing: Checks whether Surface references are unique and reciprocal and whether vertices, edges, areas, and normals correspond.
check_help.boundary: Checks internal exposure settings and uses world coordinates to find highly overlapping opposing faces in different zones that are both Outdoors.
check_help.construction: Treats construction names only as weak hints; a name never triggers a change by itself.
check_help.orphan_reference: Finds Outside Boundary Condition Object references that are missing or ambiguous.
check_help.airboundary: Checks whether AirBoundary constructions have explainable internal-boundary evidence; evidence only.

audit.running: Building the geometry evidence graph and running read-only checks…
audit.empty: Choose an IDF to run the independent model audit.
audit.no_findings: The selected rules found no model-consistency findings to show.
audit.preview_direct: The world-coordinate faces strongly overlap, oppose each other, and form a unique pair. Reciprocal Surface boundaries can be previewed, but the internal construction still needs confirmation.
audit.preview_split: The overlap is not one-to-one. Surfaces must be split or resegmented before whole-face reciprocal references are safe.
audit.auto_apply_reason: The audit does not infer an Interior Wall from construction names. The IDF stays unchanged until construction is confirmed and unified validation passes.

coincident_outdoor_surfaces.title: Opposing coincident faces are both Outdoors
coincident_outdoor_surfaces.summary: Two faces in different zones strongly overlap in world coordinates and have opposing normals; they resemble an internal adjacency rather than two exterior walls.

surface_reference_missing.title: Surface pair target is missing
surface_reference_missing.summary: The Outside Boundary Condition Object does not resolve to a target surface.

surface_reference_ambiguous.title: Surface pair target is ambiguous
surface_reference_ambiguous.summary: More than one target has that name, so no deterministic pair exists.

surface_reference_not_reciprocal.title: Surface pair is not reciprocal
surface_reference_not_reciprocal.summary: The target surface does not explicitly reference this surface back.

paired_geometry_mismatch.title: Paired-surface geometry differs
paired_geometry_mismatch.summary: Direct vertex, edge, area, or normal evidence does not correspond.

surface_topology_invalid.title: Surface topology is invalid
surface_topology_invalid.summary: The surface has duplicate vertices, self-intersection, non-coplanarity, or zero area.

internal_surface_exposure.title: Internal-surface exposure is suspicious
internal_surface_exposure.summary: An internal paired surface still declares sun or wind exposure.

construction_context_review.title: Review construction context
construction_context_review.summary: The name weakly conflicts with boundary context; a name alone never triggers a change.

airboundary_context_review.title: Review AirBoundary context
airboundary_context_review.summary: Evidence-only context is shown; no candidate is generated.

experimental.title: Geometry comparison preview
experimental.help: Compare suspicious vertices and adjacent surfaces with existing geometry evidence; every result is preview-only.
experimental.preview_only_boundary: Selecting an item only lists comparison results; it will not automatically change, write, or overwrite the IDF.
experimental.threshold_help: Changes only this preview's detection range; repair eligibility and write permission remain unchanged.
experimental.running: Building geometry evidence and running shadow validation…
experimental.empty: Choose an IDF and at least one mechanism to generate a preview.

experimental.no_mechanism_previews: This mechanism has no object-level evidence to show.

geometry_snap.name: Align displaced vertices
geometry_snap.short: Compare a displaced point with nearby trusted shared coordinates already in the model.
geometry_snap.long: Only existing model coordinates may be reused; current validation is not yet sufficient for safe automatic write-back.

geometry_pair.name: Check whether adjacent faces align
geometry_pair.short: Compare whether the faces point to each other and whether their areas, vertices, and directions correspond.
geometry_pair.long: Prior tests found a risk of changing the wrong surface, so this remains a comparison and does not write back.

geometry_four_point.name: Check a missing fourth vertex
geometry_four_point.short: Show a possible fourth point only when other geometry relationships support it too.
geometry_four_point.long: A parallelogram calculation alone does not prove a safe change; no preview is created without independent evidence.

kg623_reference.name: View kg623 reference coordinates
kg623_reference.short: Show traceable references without changing the model from them.
kg623_reference.long: A reference model may differ from the current file and cannot authorize a geometry change on its own.

osm_reference.name: View OSM source relationships
osm_reference.short: Show provenance only when an exact OSM object correspondence exists.
osm_reference.long: A repaired IDF is never reverse-translated into a whole OSM model.

airboundary.name: View air-boundary relationships
airboundary.short: Compare construction and boundary-condition evidence without automatic changes.
airboundary.long: Object fields and geometry context alone are not sufficient for direct write-back.

osm.no_writeback: The original OSM is never overwritten

migration.downgrade_not_supported: The official upgrade assistant does not downgrade files. Choose the same or a newer version.
